title: Multi-CUT&Tag to simultaneously profile multiple chromatin factors
protocol: Reconstitute Concanavalin A coated magnetic beads by suspending them in a solution.
Pipette 10 μL of resuspended beads into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube per 100,000 cells to be profiled.
Add 850 μL cold binding buffer to the beads.
Place the microcentrifuge tube on a magnetic stand for at least 2 minutes until the solution is clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Resuspend the concanavalin A beads in 1 mL binding buffer by gently pipetting.
Place the resuspended beads on a magnetic stand for 2 minutes.
After the solution has cleared, remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Repeat steps to resuspend beads in 1 mL binding buffer and place on magnetic stand.
Resuspend the concanavalin A beads in 10 μL of binding buffer after clearing the supernatant.
Trypsinize and resuspend cells to achieve a single cell suspension.
Count and add appropriate number of cells to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube in PBS.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 min at 600 g, 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Add 1 ml wash buffer and resuspend the cell pellet by gentle pipetting.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 min at 600 g, 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 0.5 ml wash buffer.
Add 10 uL activated Concanavalin A coated beads to the resuspended cells.
Incubate cells/beads for 15 min at 25°C in an end-over-end rotator.
Place the microcentrifuge tube containing Concanavalin A bead-bound cells on a magnetic stand for 2 min.
Carefully remove all liquid by pipetting.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL cold Dig-wash Buffer containing 2 mM EDTA.
Add 6 μL of each differentially barcoded purified antibody-pA-Tn5 complex to the cells.
Incubate on nutating mixer at 4°C for 4 h (or up to 12 h).
Place the microcentrifuge tube on a magnetic stand for at least 2 minutes until the solution is clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Resuspend the beads in 1 mL Dig-med Buffer by gently pipetting.
Incubate on nutating mixer for 5 minutes and then place it on magnetic stand for 2 minutes.
Discard supernatant without disturbing beads.
Repeat step of resuspending beads in 1 mL Dig-med Buffer.
Resuspend the bead-bound cells in 300 μL Dig-med Buffer containing 10 mM MgCl2 while gently vortexing.
Incubate bead-bound cells at 37°C for 60 minutes to allow transposition of adapters into DNA.
Add 10 μL 0.5 M EDTA, 3 μL 10% SDS and 1 μL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K to each sample.
Vortex on full speed and incubate for 60 minutes at 50°C or 12 hours at 37°C.
Add 300 μL of Phenol-Chloroform-Isoamyl alcohol to the tube and mix by full-speed vortexing.
Transfer to a phase-lock tube, and centrifuge for 3 minutes at 16,000 g at 25°C.
Add 300 μL chloroform to the phase lock tube containing the aqueous phase.
Mix by inversion and centrifuge for 5 min at 16,000 g at 25°C.
Remove the aqueous phase to a new tube.
Add 0.5 μg/μL glycogen and mix by vortexing well.
Add 750 μL of 100% ethanol and mix by vortexing.
Incubate at −20°C for 15 min.
Centrifuge for 15 min at 4°C at 16,000 g.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Wash the pellet in 1 mL 100% ethanol.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 16,000 × g, 4°C.
Discard any residual supernatant by pipet.
Air dry ∼5 min at 25°C.
Dissolve the pellet in 23 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH8 containing 0.1 mg/mL RNase A.
Incubate for 10 min at 37°C.
Prepare PCR mix using universal or barcoded i5 and i7 primers.
Mix gently.
Add 55 μL AMPure XP beads (1.1 volumes) to the tube from the previous step.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Place on magnet and carefully pipet off the liquid.
Without disturbing the beads, wash the beads twice with 200 μL of 80% ethanol.
Perform a quick (1–2 s) spin in a mini centrifuge.
Replace tubes on the magnet, carefully remove all remaining liquid.
Air dry the beads for 2–3 minutes.
Add 25 μL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8 to the beads and vortex on full.
Incubate at 25°C for 5 minutes.
Place cells on magnet for 2 min.
Transfer supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells at 600 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 ml wash buffer.
Transfer cells to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells at 600 g for 5 min at 4°C to remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 100 μL cold Dig-wash Buffer containing 2 mM EDTA.
Add each of the differentially barcoded purified antibody-pA-Tn5 complexes (12 μL) to the cells.
Place on nutating mixer at 4°C for approximately 12 h incubation.
Centrifuge cells at 600 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 ml Dig-med Buffer by gently pipetting.
Incubate on nutating mixer for 5 min.
Repeat wash steps 52 and 53 three times.
Count cells during the last wash.
Resuspend cells in Dig-med Buffer at a concentration of 5000 cells/μL.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Add an equal volume of Dig-med Buffer containing 20 mM MgCl2 to the tagmentation reaction.
Incubate samples at 37°C for 60 minutes.
Use 2.5 μL of the tagmentation reaction (2500 cells/μL) for targeted cell recovery of 4000 cells.
Mix 61.5 μL of barcoding reagent with 1.5 μL of Reducing Agent B and 2 μL of barcoding enzyme to prepare the barcoding master mix.
Load the samples and Gel beads to Chromium Chip E following the 10× Genomics User protocol.
Incubate the GEMs in a thermocycler with an amplification cycle program.
Remove leftover biochemical reagents from the post GEM reaction mixture using Silane magnetic beads.
Eliminate unused barcodes from the sample using AMPure XP beads.
Perform single cell multi-CUT&Tag library construction according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Generate single cell libraries using sample indexing primers according to the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell ATAC Reagent Kits v1.1 User Guide.
Perform 14 cycles of PCR for library construction.
Conduct a double-sided size selection post sample index PCR using AMPure XP beads.
Dilute 1 μL of the library and determine its concentration using KAPA Library Quantification Kit.
Determine the library size distribution by Fragment Analyzer.
Sequence multi-CUT&Tag libraries using custom sequencing primers.
Mix custom read primers for library and PhiX Control v3 together for the run.
Use manual mode on the Illumina NextSeq 500 for sequencing.
Perform paired-end sequencing using a 150 cycle sequencing kit.
Run read 1 for 72 cycles.
Run read 2 for 72 cycles.
Run index 1 for 8 cycles (for bulk multi-CUT&Tag) or 16 cycles (for single cell multi-CUT&Tag).
Run index 2 for 8 cycles (for bulk multi-CUT&Tag) or 16 cycles (for single cell multi-CUT&Tag).
Add PhiX Control v3 at 20%–30% per reaction.
